d: Kshatrap philipas ki hatya ke uprant yavnon ki sena se alag ho bhartiy sainik vapis laut rahe hain, aur gramvasi unhen svatantrata senani samajh unki seva karte hai ye janne ke uprant bhi ki vo bhratak yoddha hain. gram pradhan kahta hai, bhratak hain to kya phir bhi hain to bhartiy hi. yoddha gramvasiyon ke is sneh se kritagy hai. aage kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men.
